description: Find MPs and peers by name, location or constituency, party, House, and current or historical membership. currentOnly=false includes current and former members. asOf selects historical membership and accepts name only, without House, party or location filters. Search results preserve latest profile fields; retrieve sections with ukparl_get_member. Follow opaque cursors with unchanged filters and use contentCursor for oversized records.
